statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-102474 describes a heap write in the printf/echo %b Unicode \u and \U escape path in newer dash sources. Debian dash 0.5.12 (the upstream version in this package) does not implement those Unicode escapes in conv_escape; only octal and basic C escapes are supported. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-102474

CVE-2026-102473 applies to dash when built with the internal pmatch() matcher (configure --disable-fnmatch). This rebuild configures dash with --enable-fnmatch so pathname globbing uses libc fnmatch(3) instead. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-102473
